summary: PlacementCalendar implements an interactive, filterable calendar view for managing placement requests and schedules across multiple organizational contexts (e.g., agencies, sites, disciplines, services, destinations) with features for status tracking, batch actions, and advanced scheduling management. It supports multiple calendar views (term, month, week, year), filtering by multiple dimension fields, and provides UI for batch status updates, linking requests, and printing or generating correspondence.
purpose: The PlacementCalendar allows authorized users (primarily Placing Coordinators and Receiving Coordinators) to visualize and manipulate placement requests over time periods, filter and process requests, perform batch actions (status changes, printouts, correspondence), and navigate to related workflows like worksheets or enrollment modules.

workflows.name: Filter Placement Requests
steps: User selects filters: agency, site, service, destination, department, program, cohort, course, discipline, date range, status, invoice status, and calendar view mode.
Placement requests are loaded and displayed per the selected filter parameters.
Available actions depend on user's access level and screen mode.

workflows.name: Batch Update Placement Request Statuses
steps: User selects one or more placement requests using checkboxes.
User selects a new status from ddNewStatus and (optionally) provides required reason and notes.
System validates required fields (dates, reasons, reason notes if 'Other', etc).
Batch update is processed. Results and any errors/warnings are displayed.

workflows.name: Placement Calendar Navigation
steps: User can view calendar in term, month, week, or year mode.
Navigation buttons (prev/next) move the calendar period accordingly.
Clicking on calendar bar elements can drill-down to finer granularity or related details.

workflows.name: Link and Unlink Placement Requests
steps: User marks requests for linking (adds to tray).
System ensures more than one distinct request selected.
User invokes link action. Requests are grouped together.
Unlinking is possible on parent requests as permitted.

workflows.name: Print or Generate Correspondence
steps: User selects requests and chooses action to print or generate correspondence.
Relevant parameters are collected (reply by date, type, individual PDFs, etc).
System creates print jobs or triggers correspondence generation as required.

business_rules: User's access level determines available filters, actions, and editability.
If no agency/site/service/destination is selected, defaults are auto-populated to prevent invalid queries.
Advanced schedule creation (splits/clones) is allowed only for certain statuses and user roles.
Batch actions (status update, print, etc) require at least one request selected.
Validation: End date must be after start date. 'Other' reasons require notes.
Invoice status and related actions appear only when invoicing module is enabled and user is permitted.
Linking is only performed if two or more distinct requests are selected.
Special actions (undo last status change, merge requests, etc) require system administrator.
validations: Start and end dates are required and validated for order.
Required fields (reason, notes) enforced by validator controls.
Cannot perform batch actions with no requests selected.
On batch update, 'Other' reason requires non-empty notes.
Rejects linking if only a single distinct request is marked.
calculations: Calendar grid rendering intervals (term: 17x1week, month: 4x7days, year: 13x28days) adjust date ranges automatically.
ShiftLength is shown, rounded to 2 decimals, and shifts are determined per placement and amendments.
Placement bar representations are dynamically calculated based on placement request schedule, amendments, and display mode.
conditions: Calendar view changes available columns and controls (e.g., shifts in week mode, days column suppression).
Visibility of action panels, warnings, and error panels changes dynamically based on page state.
Batch actions and control enablement vary based on editAllowed, user role, and invoicing mode.
system_behavior: Maintains user session and filter state across reloads and postbacks.
Links to advanced workflows (enrollment, worksheet, group worksheet) when matching filter context is found.
Processes batch actions and displays user-friendly warnings/errors as appropriate.
Hides/disables controls and columns not applicable to the current filter or user access.
Recalculates paging and refreshes display after any action affecting underlying data.
dependencies: User session management and role logic (UserSession, RoleConstants, StatusCodeFormatter).
Amendments and shifts logic for calendar rendering.
Codes and lookups: PlacementStatuses, PlacementInvoiceStatuses, Disciplines, Programs, Sites.
External print job and correspondence modules for actions.
exceptions: No data or invalid filter: shows empty table and/or appropriate warnings.
Attempt to link with fewer than two unique requests: error.
Invalid transition for status change: displays help link.
Site, service, or destination not found: reverts filter to 'ALL'.

content_gaps: Resource and code lists (such as status code values, shift GIFs, some tooltips, etc.) refer to external resource files and are only referenced, not defined, in the page/user controls.
Detailed implementation of print job creation, advanced schedule split/clone, and specific amendment logic rely on external modules.
